obfuscation_indicators: ongoing improvement in demand and pricing
risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified detail, but highlights materially weak demand, excess industry capacity, pricing pressure, reduced margins, goodwill impairment, asbestos liabilities, and acquisition-related losses. Management identifies potential improvement in demand and pricing, though these outlook statements remain conditional and depend on uncertain market conditions. Accounting estimates and provisional purchase-price allocations introduce additional earnings and valuation risk.
